notes: Each of the four chains in the fish/birds/beasts/field series is rendered with a 'the' before both words, so under rule 29's arthrous case the article takes the one before its own noun and the construct takes a supplied one; nothing is fronted. Eleven article morphemes against thirteen written 'the's balances exactly with one unrepresented article and four supplied.
The article on הָרֶמֶשׂ is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'all creeping things' with no 'the', while the following הָרֹמֵשׂ takes the relative 'that' under rule 41.
The opening waw takes 'so that' as one rendering under rule 55, headed on the coordinator, with heading on 'that' recorded as the competing reading the corpus also allows.
